title: JC H2 biology — cell: ultrastructure and biomolecules
subject: science

objectives.text: Relate membrane and nucleus structure to function
successCriteria: I can explain why phospholipid tails face inward in the fluid mosaic
I can trace an instruction from chromatin to mRNA leaving the nucleus
assessmentPoints: Opening questions in the membrane activity

objectives.text: Trace energy release in mitochondria and energy capture in chloroplasts
successCriteria: I can follow glucose in and carbon dioxide out of the mitochondrion
I can say where in the chloroplast light energy is captured

objectives.text: Follow one protein along the RER, SER and Golgi export line
successCriteria: I can order the organelles a secreted protein passes through
I can state what changes at the Golgi apparatus

objectives.text: Choose and interpret the four classic biomolecule tests
successCriteria: I can pick the correct test for each biomolecule
I can state the positive result colour for each test
assessmentPoints: Test-selection answers in the tests activity

objectives.text: Correct the misconception that plant cells lack mitochondria
successCriteria: I can explain why plant cells need mitochondria as well as chloroplasts
I can name the process mitochondria carry out in plant cells
assessmentPoints: Responses when the trap is sprung

differentiation.stretch: Ask why muscle cells carry far more mitochondria than skin cells.

activities.title: Recap the cell as a system
